While some hierarchy may be functional in certain forms, an ideal society should strive to minimize unnecessary stratification and ensure that any hierarchy exists only to serve the common good, not to perpetuate disadvantage or oppression. The continual re-examination and reform of social structures is essential in pursuing true social equality and justice.
